description: This file implements a network connection multiplexer (cmux) in Go, providing functionality to match, serve, and handle network connections based on custom matchers and writers, including error handling and connection sniffing.

classes.name: ErrNotMatched
classes.description: Error returned when a connection does not match any registered matcher.

classes.name: muxListener
classes.description: Custom listener that manages accepted connections and shutdown signaling.

classes.name: cMux
classes.description: Main struct implementing the CMux interface, managing matchers, listeners, and connection serving.

classes.name: MuxConn
classes.description: Wrapper around net.Conn providing connection sniffing capabilities.

methods.name: matchersToMatchWriters
methods.description: Converts a list of Matchers to MatchWriters.

methods.name: Match
methods.description: Registers matchers and returns a net.Listener for matched connections.

methods.name: MatchWithWriters
methods.description: Registers matchers with writers and returns a net.Listener for matched connections.

methods.name: SetReadTimeout
methods.description: Sets the read timeout for matchers.

methods.name: Serve
methods.description: Starts the multiplexing server, accepting and dispatching connections.

methods.name: serve
methods.description: Handles individual connection serving and matching logic.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the CMux server and associated resources.

methods.name: HandleError
methods.description: Registers an error handler for the server.

methods.name: handleErr
methods.description: Processes errors using the registered error handler.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts a connection from the muxListener.

methods.name: newMuxConn
methods.description: Creates a new MuxConn wrapping a net.Conn.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from the MuxConn, supporting connection sniffing.

methods.name: startSniffing
methods.description: Prepares the connection for sniffing by resetting buffers.

methods.name: doneSniffing
methods.description: Finalizes sniffing process by resetting buffers.
